newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 280 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 280 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 280 contracts compared to 295 contracts a day earlier, according to the CBOT.
There were 16 wheat, 80 corn, 125 soybean, 48 soymeal, 10 soyoil and one oats futures contracts traded, along with one soybean call and three wheat call options.
Corn was 3/4 to one cent per bushel lower, wheat three cents lower, soybeans up 1/4 to down 1/2 cent, soymeal up $2.60 to 10 cents a ton, soyoil up 0.05 cent per lb and oats down 1-1/4 cents.
